title: Patagonia Run 2027 — The destination: San Martín de los Andes (official)
claims: Aviador Carlos Campos Airport (Chapelco, CPC) is 22 km from the centre of San Martín de los Andes, about 35 minutes by paved road.
Teniente Luis Candelaria International Airport (Bariloche, BRC) is 190 km from San Martín de los Andes, about three hours via National Route 40 and the Seven Lakes Route.
San Martín de los Andes is connected by National Route 40 and National Route 234, and the Seven Lakes Route links it with Villa La Angostura over about 110 km.
The main road border crossings from Chile are the Mamuil Malal Pass and the Hua Hum Pass.
The official destination page gives an autumn average temperature range of 3 °C to 18 °C.
